修撰 is the Hanlin compiler (senior compiler), not an expositor; 甫冠 means just reaching twenty.
When the Zhengde Emperor came to the throne, he was appointed vice minister of rites and also served as lecturer and reader at court.
When the Zhengde Emperor came to the throne, he was promoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and also served as lecturer and reader at court.
太常少卿 is vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, not of the Ministry of Rites.

Hong's younger cousin, the Hanlin compiler Cai, was married to the sister of Chenhao's wife; learning of the plot, he told Hong.
編修 is a Hanlin compiler, not an expositor.
When the Veritable Records of the Zhengde Emperor were completed, Hong proposed posting Chun out as an administration vice commissioner, and Shu bore a grudge from that day.
When the Veritable Records of the Zhengde Emperor were completed, Hong proposed posting Chun out as an assistant surveillance commissioner, and Shu bore a grudge from that day.
僉事 here is an assistant (surveillance) commissioner, not an administration vice commissioner.
Cong and E had entered the Hanlin from the secretariat and were suddenly made tutors to the heir apparent; the whole court detested them.
Cong and E had entered the Hanlin from the ministry secretariats and were suddenly made supervisors of the Household of the Heir Apparent; the whole court detested them.
詹事 is the Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent, a specific office rather than tutors.
孫思誠 under Li Chunfang means "his grandson Sicheng" (surname Li), not a person named Sun Sicheng.

When he returned as junior guardian, his younger brother Cai was an assistant tutor, his nephew Maozhong had placed first in the metropolitan examination and become an expositor, and his eldest son Maoxian had just become a Hanlin bachelor — father, sons, and brothers all held posts close to the throne.

When he returned as junior guardian, his younger brother Cai was an admonisher, his nephew Maozhong, having passed the palace examination in the top tier, had become a Hanlin compiler, and his eldest son Maoxian had just become a Hanlin bachelor — father, sons, and brothers all held posts close to the throne.
贊善 is an admonisher; 進士及第 is the top tier of the palace examination; 編修 is a compiler.

Hong's eldest paternal uncle Xuan passed the metropolitan examination in Chenghua 11.
世父 means the eldest paternal uncle, not a "clan elder father".

參議 is an assistant administration commissioner.
